messages:
sara: idea for a compact composite sentry for v4q-longchat onboarding. want a single gate that combines quality/latency/cost so we can do sane autofallbacks without a pile of independent rules.

devin: short and sweet. what metrics would feed the sentry?

sara: thinking: delta-MRR (negative), named-entity halluc rate (up), p99 latency absolute + pct uplift, and delta tokens-per-response. normalize each to 0..1 and do a weighted sum. fallback if combined_score >= 0.8 sustained over 5 minutes.

kai: we should treat long prompts differently. on >3k tokens, increase latency weight and relax small MRR dips. also protect small-cohort noise: require either canary_traffic_pct >= 1.5% OR >=2 independent slices firing.

olga: can you show a draft policy blob so I can pass to the routing/orch team?

sara: pasted below. it's intentionally compact for the orchestration API.

```json
{
  "policy":"composite_sentry_v0",
  "inputs":["mrr_delta","ner_halluc_pct","latency_p99_ms","tokens_delta_pct"],
  "weights":[0.5,0.2,0.2,0.1],
  "normalize":"minmax",
  "latency":{
    "absolute_p99_ms":400,
    "pct_uplift_threshold":0.25
  },
  "scoring":{
    "method":"weighted_sum",
    "trigger_score":0.8,
    "sustain_minutes":5
  },
  "context_rules":[
    {"if":"seq_len>3000","apply":{"weights_mul":{"latency":1.6,"mrr":0.8}}}
  ],
  "safety_preconds":{"min_canary_pct":1.5,"min_slices":2},
  "actions":{"on_alert":"notify:#eng-ml","on_auto":"rollback_and_tag_incident"}
}
```

devin: small ask: use dual thresholds for auto vs ops alert. alert at 0.65 (10m smoothing) and auto-rollback at 0.85 (3m sustained) plus the safety_preconds. ops prefer conservative autos.

sara: fine by me. will set alert_score=0.65 (10m) and auto_score=0.85 (3m) in the staged config.

mira: add a synthetic set that targets rare named entities and multi-turn coherence so hallucination signal surfaces faster. Also add a tiny shadow-sample of customer longdocs.

sara: good call. adding to eval harness now. starting a 30m shadow run and will post the small-metrics snapshot once available.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary start for model:v4q-longchat at 2026-03-23T16:05:00Z (cohort=0.5%). hooks: mrr, ner_halluc_pct, latency_p99_ms, tokens_per_resp.

devin: thanks @deploy-bot. one more: can Console surface per-signal contribution (bars) and the computed combined_score so oncall can see why a trigger happened?

olga: telemetry already gives per-signal series; we just need a small front-end calc. I'll coordinate with devex.

sara: plan: push the staged composite_sentry_v0 with alert_score=0.65 (10m), auto_score=0.85 (3m), safety_preconds enforced, and the synthetic eval set. tagging @eng-ml for a quick smoke tomorrow morning.

mira: acked. please link the shadow result later. thanks all :raised_hands:
